band_boundaries.$doc: UNSET on purpose. The approved calibration set (A3) puts the Expert line near 0.52; Eric's graded staged sample puts it near 0.62-0.65 with only ~20% precision. The two disagree; Eric decides. See reports/en-recalibration-2026-10-16.md.

calibration_bar.$doc: A3 bar. Spec default was 0.90 / 0.05. Amended by Eric 2026-10-16 (option 3): the score is sound-based and cannot see lexical exceptions (supersede, harass). No new data source was approved; the wordfreq misspelling-ratio boost was NOT adopted.

d4_amendment.$doc: Eric 2026-10-16 ('1 and 2'): Expert CANDIDATES may be admitted from Zipf 2.0-4.0 (was 2.5-4.0), shortlist-and-grade only; nothing below 2.5 goes live without his grading.
